title: Hold a petroleum production licence (NSW coastal waters)
what: Hold a petroleum production licence before recovering petroleum in Western Australia's coastal waters (the adjacent area).

sources.title: Petroleum (Submerged Lands) Act 1982 (WA)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on operations for the recovery of petroleum or a regulated substance in the adjacent area except — (a) under and in accordance with a petroleum production licence;
